PatchLab can find the Art-Net nodes on the network, and send them the configuration from your plan. Open the Tasks page, and click Devices on the network.
Choose how the universe numbers are counted. Luminex shows universe one where Art-Net says zero, so the default is one less. Then scan the network.
Every node that answers is listed with its address and name. PatchLab matches it to a node of your plan, by IP address, by name, or by MAC address.
The status says what differs: the name, the universe of a port, or the address. This node still has its factory name and the wrong universes.
Tick the nodes you want to configure. Changing the IP address is a separate tick, because the node moves.
Press send. You see exactly what will change on every node, and nothing happens until you confirm.
After sending, PatchLab scans again and checks the result, so you know the node really has the new settings.
For switches, the second tab checks that each planned address answers, and makes a sheet with port, device and VLAN for every switch.
